environment.description: Same Ktor microservice deployed on EKS cluster in eu-west-1. Service is behind an internal NLB (scheme=internal) in private subnets (10.40.0.0/16). The NLB target group health check path is /health. Upstream traffic arrives only through an envoy sidecar mesh (Istio 1.19) with a PeerAuthentication policy requiring STRICT mTLS. The mesh's AuthorizationPolicy resource specifies source principal matching: 'cluster.local/ns/bi-dashboard/sa/dashboard-renderer' and 'cluster.local/ns/monitoring/sa/prometheus'. Additionally, a Cilium L3/L4 NetworkPolicy (CiliumNetworkPolicy kind) restricts ingress to the pod to CIDR 10.40.12.0/24 (the BI dashboard pod subnet) and 10.40.8.0/28 (monitoring). The VPC has no internet gateway attached, no NAT gateway egress, and the NLB has no public-facing listener. DNS resolution for the service is only available within the mesh via CoreDNS stub zone 'reporting.internal.mesh'.

config.dns_resolution: internal mesh only via CoreDNS stub zone
